newsitem.title: USA: Chief of Staff to Philadelphia Mayor resigns.
newsitem.headline: Chief of Staff to Philadelphia Mayor resigns.

text.p: David Cohen, architect of Philadelphia Mayor Ed Rendell's five-year turnaround of city finances, is resigning to take the helm of one of Philadelphia's most prestigious law firms.
Cohen, 41, announced he would leave next Spring to become chief executive officer of Ballard, Spahr, Andrews & Ingersoll.
He left that firm to join Rendell's administration in 1991, when the city faced a cumulative deficit of $200 million and a state-appointed commission had been created to oversee city finances.
Rendell announced last week that Philadelphia had finished its fiscal year with a $118 million surplus.
Cohen will succeed Peter Mattoon as chairman of Ballard Spahr in 13 months.
